title: BFF Bootcamp

services.name: BFF Bootcamp
services.desc: Our movement Monday workouts are our traditional circuit style workouts. We start off with a series of 4 exercises targeting total body at a circuit pace, then in our second series, offer a send circuit which may be strength based or cardio based. Our third series focuses on helping you develop push up strength, pull up strength, and core strength. All in one hour! 6 exercises. Lots of low tempo strength training mixed with a little bit of high tempo cardio training. Some boxing, some kickboxing, some Muay Thai, but LOTS of cardio and stress

services.name: Boxing Training
services.desc: Sometimes you just need to put the weights down and hit something! Have you had a rough week? Boxing can be your antidote! We alternate between cardio based boxing workouts and technique based boxing days to give you the best of both worlds.
